flagged.location: First prose paragraph, final clause “the last counterexample uses both witnesses”
flagged.evidence: The page says: “The final comparison exhibits the dimensional dichotomy at the heart of Huygens' principle: a three-dimensional spherical pulse leaves a quiet interior behind its expanding front, while the two-dimensional pulse keeps a positive tail at the centre after the front has passed; the last counterexample uses both witnesses to show that finite propagation does not imply strong Huygens.” The cited counterexample's Proof 1.1–1.2 instead gives one-dimensional and two-dimensional interior-data witnesses; its later witnesses concern regularity and positivity. It contains no three-dimensional quiet-interior witness, so the clause misidentifies what that counterexample uses.
